request.description: Applies to the chosen offer: records the applicant's consent naming that lender (choosing and confirming in the app is the selection the sharing consent asks for) and creates the submission for ops approval. `id` is the submission reference; `status` stays `under_review` until a final lender decision. Compat layer for the current app (plan §10.3): the app sets `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=<host>/v0`. The case is the borrower's newest open application, resolved server side because the app never sends one. Removed once the app moves to `/v1`.
